scope: Synthetic supported native BREP bulge; no routing

oracle.method: All-net actual-copper continuity and isolation; policy=physical-network. Every ground pad piece shares one physical copper component containing an actual copper pour; direct TOP pour contact is optional. Every graph net must have all actual terminal pieces in one physical copper component and no foreign terminal contact; non-ground nets need no pour. Per-layer polygon contact and physical plated barrels join layers. Positive connectivity uses inscribed copper/circumscribed drills and minimum endpoint trace width; short detection reverses bounds and uses maximum width. No electrical union by source trace, connectivity key, logical terminal alias or declared net. Rounded contacts are bounded48-gons;1e-6mm coordinate touch tolerance. Not impedance, manufactured-board proof.
